title: Home practical guide and safety card: taking a cutting
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Dissolving, separating and plants (Do All Solids Dissolve? and Allotment)
source: Written for science/y5 lesson 38 (Home practical guide and safety card: taking a cutting (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 38: New plants without seeds; unit quiz. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To grow a new plant from a cutting
equipment: A healthy plant such as mint, a spider plant or a geranium
A glass of water or a small pot of compost
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Ask an adult to cut a stem about 10 cm long, just below a leaf joint
Stand the stem in water (or push it into damp compost)
Put it in a bright place out of strong sun
Change the water every few days
Look for roots every two days and measure them

questions.q: A strawberry runner makes plants that are...
Big question: how can a gardener get ten identical strawberry plants?
questions.a: Pot up the plants that grow from its runners.
